text:
Which statements about the alloy brass are correct?
1
It is harder than pure copper.
2
It does not conduct electricity.
3
It is a mixture of copper and nickel.
4
It is stronger than pure copper.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry

content.html: It is harder than pure copper. It does not conduct electricity. It is a mixture of copper and nickel. It is stronger than pure copper.
